name: Trempealeau County, WI
findings: Trempealeau County has 106 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Trempealeau County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Trempealeau County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Trempealeau County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
